Inborn glycerol metabolism disorder; adrenal hypoplasia and Duchenne dystrophy occur in associated complex forms. Acute altered consciousness does not establish lasting CNS damage.

Congenital pulmonary artery absence; definition describes typical structural lung changes, with abnormal lung imaging in 30-79%. Bronchiectasis alone occurs below 30%.
Immune-mediated panniculitis directly inflames subcutaneous fat; associated systemic diseases are separate conditions.
Peroxisomal disorder; intellectual disability and neurologic dysfunction in 1/1, cataracts in 2/2, progressive hearing loss in 1/1. Frequencies derive from very small samples.
Testicular germ cell malignancy affects a reproductive organ; no endocrine dysfunction or other axis is defining.
Benign proliferation of blood vessels in the skin defines acquired elastotic haemangioma.
Inherited high myopia with retinal detachment and cataract; all reported manifestations remain within the ocular axis.
